subject: the provider operations OpenCode calls through AEW's provider relay, by provider: what the relay's default operations (relay.DEFAULT_OPERATIONS) must keep forwarding

source.how: derived, not measured in this pull request: the pinned 2.2.6 binary was not installable from the package registry where this fixture was made, so no live session was driven. Each call is taken from evidence already in the repository, named per call
evidence: tests/fixtures/opencode/usage-2.2.6-openai.json and usage-2.2.6-opencode-responses.json: live turns through the relay on the Responses route
tools/harness_qualify/worker_plan.py: the keyless plan-login qualification records the paths OpenCode sent through the relay (POST /backend-api/codex/responses alone)
tools/harness_qualify/model.py: the qualification's scripted upstream serves POST <base>/responses and counts a WebSocket upgrade, which the relay answers 501 before its operation scope
src/aew/harness/containment/relay.py _operation: the model-call routes of each provider SDK the projection relays

calls.evidence: the chat-completions route of an OpenAI-compatible provider (relay._operation)
the Anthropic SDK's messages route (relay._operation); not measured live
the Google SDK's streaming route (relay._operation); not measured live
kept by default for a client that lists its provider's models; OpenCode reads its catalog from models.dev through the egress proxy instead
